acceptanceCriteria: A focused test shows a sidecar-declared binding proves a template hop that is otherwise unresolved.
body:
Source: w6 appmap-impact lane report (2026-10-11), branch claude/w6-appmap-impact 31fb799d8.

Observed: the V1-1162 template hop has no way to take owner-declared component bindings.

Expected: an optional owner-declared component-bindings sidecar supplies bindings for the template hop, with project authority outranking inferred syntax.
title: Optional owner-declared component-bindings sidecar for the V1-1162 template hop
